integrity: Universal statements are proved analytically; a standalone standard-library script performs finite illustrative checks only. No external or independent scientific audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Sharp conditional one-step expected quadratic energy for exact iid single-coordinate sampling on a two-parameter SPD correlation family. Does not imply multi-step, adaptive, or wall-clock optimality. E-optimal design equivalence in less accessible literature remains a residual novelty risk.
title: Mode-switching optimal sampling for one-exception correlation quadratics
